name: UT Bot V4
description: ATR-based trailing stop that flips direction when price closes on the opposite side of the stop line, producing bull and bear flip signals.
author: user

output_descriptions.BULL_TREND: Price is above the ATR trailing stop and position is long (stop ratcheting upward beneath price)
output_descriptions.BEAR_TREND: Price is below the ATR trailing stop and position is short (stop ratcheting downward above price)
output_descriptions.BULL_FLIP: Current bar: previous close was at or below the trailing stop and current close crossed above it — bullish direction flip bar
output_descriptions.BEAR_FLIP: Current bar: previous close was at or above the trailing stop and current close crossed below it — bearish direction flip bar

triggers.name: Bull Flip (Price Crosses Above Trail Stop)
Bear Flip (Price Crosses Below Trail Stop)
